verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Canny serves a working llms.txt at https://developers.canny.io/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured developer documentation content, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. This is corroborated by first-party developer docs and an official MCP server offering, reinforcing agent-native access to Canny's resources. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of llms.txt usage/quality beyond the probe.
